expectations: PARAMETER_STORE environment variable value contains the parameter name, substituted by CodeBuild at runtime
The service role needs ssm:GetParameters on that parameter
GetParameters supports explicit Names; GetParametersByPath cannot safely enforce child-parameter denies
docker build --secret id=npm_token,env=NPM_TOKEN passes a secret without a build argument

Task secrets accept Key Vault URLs, volumes encode secret files and volumeMounts mount them into build steps
A task system-assigned identity accesses Key Vault; the runtime identity need not have access
TaskRunRequest references taskId and overrides contextPath and values without recreating the task
